node: Coffee, tea, extract, beverage, and private-label supply for restaurants and foodservice
summary: Layer 1B expansion for this node finds a narrow public universe. The cleanest underfollowed direct exposure is Westrock Coffee, which explicitly discloses coffee, tea, flavors, extracts, ingredients, private-label, foodservice, restaurant, convenience-store, travel-center and hospitality exposure. Farmer Bros. and Coffee Holding are much smaller, higher-risk speculative shadows with direct coffee/private-label/foodservice relevance but sub-USD-300M market caps. Keurig Dr Pepper is included only as a reference/platform anchor because it owns major coffee systems and beverage brands but is less pure to restaurant/private-label supply. TreeHouse Foods would have been a relevant private-label beverage/coffee node, but it was taken private and delisted in February 2026, so it is excluded from the candidate list.
